name: plangraph
description: A small knowledge graph for planning with Claude Code: tickets, dependency links, readiness verdicts with evidence fingerprints, schedules, and learnings. Text in git, a cheap query CLI, no model calls.

card.title: Session-start card
card.description: Opt-in. Set to auto to inject the short plan card at session start. Default off; the plangraph command and skills work either way.

mcp.title: Plan graph MCP server
mcp.description: Opt-in. Set to on to start the read-only plangraph MCP server (map, context, flow_next, ready, ticket, whatif, graph). Default off; the plangraph command and skills work either way.

prompt_hook.title: Prompt hook
prompt_hook.description: Opt-in. Set to on to add owner and blockers of a ticket named in your prompt (UserPromptSubmit). Default off: the hook is registered but exits silently.
